company.name: Arabian Plastic Industrial Co. Ltd.
company.shortDescription: Arabian Plastic Industrial Company produces plastic packaging, containers, and custom-molded industrial components.
company.description: Arabian Plastic Industrial Company is a manufacturer within the packaging sector. The organization specializes in injection molding, film extrusion, blow molding, and thermoforming production services. It manufactures disposable products, heavy-duty shopping bags, loop handle bags, wicketed bags, and grip hole containers. The business produces custom molded crates, battery accessories, and specialized plastic components based on client blueprints.
